sourceEvidence.quote:
* A Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related technical field, along with 5+ years of experience in manufacturing and quality functions.
* Experience leading, coaching, or developing others; 2+ years of formal leadership experience is preferred.
* Strong customer and supplier management experience, with the ability to communicate effectively on complex quality issues and escalate appropriately when needed.
* Experience with process management, organizational change, Six Sigma, Lean methodologies, and quality management systems.
* Preferred qualifications include quality certifications (CQE, CMQ, CQA), ISO 9001:2015 Internal Auditor training, sheet-steel manufacturing experience, and/or Certified Welding Inspector (CWI) certification.
